_: The contract between keeper_core and its TypeScript mirror src/lib/notes/attach.ts. Both test suites load this file. `vectors` pins notes::attach::embedded_attachment_names (Story 45.13, FR-188, FR-189): `embedded` is the sorted, lower-cased set of file names the body already EMBEDS. `noteTargets` pins notes::export::names_a_note (Story 46.11): `isNote` is whether an embed target names a NOTE rather than a file to attach — the rule that decides both what the Attachments panel lists and what the in-vault chooser offers, and the rule export::plan uses to decide what an export carries. Adding a vector is how you widen a rule; changing one is a product decision.
